# signalr-presence-hub

> Track user presence and room membership across server instances through a pluggable backplane, with sequence-checked deltas, snapshot resync and heartbeat expiry NuGet package `Trysac.SignalrPresenceHub`, namespace `Trysac.SignalrPresenceHub`, MIT
> licensed, .NET >= 10, base class library only.
